description: Intensity profiles for calibrated pushback in the Workplace Communication dojo (Phase 6). Productive challenge is an orchestration function: intensity is set with the user, escalated by explicit policy, de-escalated on overwhelm. Never a free-form personality trait of the persona. Workplace extension: power-gradient sensitivity — when the persona outranks the user (manager/stakeholder), de-escalation priority is raised and over-deference markers are treated as overwhelm-equivalent.

user_agreement.note: intensity level is set with the user at session start; escalation follows the agreed policy (proficiency_gated by default); de-escalation is available at any moment

levels.name: warm_up
levels.when: first sessions, new persona, re-entry after break, low confidence

levels.name: standard
levels.persona_behavior: realistic workplace friction: mild priority conflict, occasional counterpoints, scheduling friction

levels.name: challenging
levels.persona_behavior: sustained defense of the counterpart's priorities; requires evidence for claims; deadline pressure
levels.when: user requests; proficiency at level 2 sustained

levels.name: stress
levels.persona_behavior: power gradient active (manager/stakeholder), group audience, public stakes, cumulative pressure
levels.when: pre-deployment stress testing; explicit user consent

levels.name: gauntlet
levels.persona_behavior: multi-party rotation (2 personas in a group meeting), hostile stakeholder stance
levels.when: stress-test extension; explicit user consent; rarely

escalation_policies.rule: escalate only after rubric evidence shows sustained proficiency at current level (e.g., ≥2 explicit asks with owner + deadline per 5 turns)
escalate immediately on user request, any level
escalate after N sessions at level (default 3), with user agreement

deescalation_rules.action: drop to level 1 immediately; restore autonomy
drop to level 1; coach checks in; power-gradient note recorded
signal_examples: user defers all judgment to the persona
user shifts to pure agreement after pushback

deescalation_rules.action: any level to any level, immediately

sycophancy_guard.response: orchestration function recalibrates: persona raises a grounded counterpoint; agreement rate returns to profile
sycophancy_guard.note: challenge is orchestrated, not a personality trait of the persona
sycophancy_guard.mirror_note: with manager/stakeholder personas, USER agreement is also monitored: over-deference is the sycophancy mirror and is de-escalated per deescalation_rules
